# TapeBackup.org: LTO Tape Backup and Price Tracker

> Independent reference for LTO (Linear Tape-Open) tape backup: current LTO-6 to LTO-10 cartridge and drive prices from seller listings, price history since September 2025, buying guides, backup software comparisons and short technical answers.

## Current LTO prices (September 2026, checked 17 September 2026)
- [LTO-6 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto6-price): 2.5 TB native; cartridge $38.00 to $56.45 ($15.20 to $22.58 per TB); WORM $71.29 to $95.00; external drive $4,937.
- [LTO-7 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto7-price): 6 TB native; cartridge $59.99 to $79.99 ($10.00 to $13.33 per TB); WORM $93.08 to $111.72; internal drive $3,419 to $4,253; external drive $3,699 to $4,999.
- [LTO-8 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto8-price): 12 TB native; cartridge $69.95 to $80.00 ($5.83 to $6.67 per TB); WORM $100.77 to $170.00; internal drive $4,850 to $8,099; external drive $5,309 to $8,441.
- [LTO-9 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto9-price): 18 TB native; cartridge $92.45 to $111.55 ($5.14 to $6.20 per TB); WORM $124.94 to $195.00; internal drive $7,699 to $13,500; external drive $8,999 to $13,385.
- [LTO-10 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto10-price): 30 TB native; cartridge $256.00 to $299.99 ($8.53 to $10.00 per TB); WORM $420.00 to $460.80; external drive $22,165 to $24,950.
- LTO-10 40 TB cartridge: $491.00 to $555.00 ($12.28 to $13.88 per TB). LTO-10 drives are full height only and do not read older generations.

## Core pages
- [LTO price tracker](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend): all generations side by side with method and market notes.
- [LTO price history](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/history): archived snapshots from September 2025 onward.
- [Backup calculator](https://tapebackup.org/backup-calculator): tape, disk or cloud recommendation with cartridge count and media cost.
- [Tape backup software finder](https://tapebackup.org/backup-software-finder) and [best tape backup software 2026](https://tapebackup.org/best-tape-backup-software).
- [Why tape](https://tapebackup.org/why-tape), [LTO tape explained](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape), [LTO capacity chart](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-capacity), [LTO tape drive buying guide](https://tapebackup.org/why-tape/lto-tape-drive), [LTO tape libraries](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-library), [LTFS](https://tapebackup.org/resources/ltfs), [LTO tape data recovery](https://tapebackup.org/resources/lto-tape-data-recovery), [LTO tape lifespan](https://tapebackup.org/why-tape/lto-tape-lifespan), [LTO tape news](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-news), [LTO vs HDD](https://tapebackup.org/why-tape/lto-vs-hdd), [LTO tape brands](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-brand).
